notablePrerequisites:
You control nonland permanents that can tap for at least {3}{W}.
You control at least 2 additional Merfolk permanents.
description:
Cast Summon the School for {3}{W}.
Paradox Egine triggers, untapping your nonlands permanents.
Tap your nonland permanents for at least {3}{W}.
Summon the School resolves, creating two 1/1 Merfolk tokens.
Tap 4 Merfolk you control to return Summon the School to your hand.
Repeat for infinite mana, storm, and merfolk tokens.
